title: The Glue-Dotted Paper Boat
youtube_title: The Glue-Dotted Paper Boat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Paz wants to check on a paper boat whose dots of glue were still tacky before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Paz leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
